name: teach-me
description: Learn while Claude codes. After a turn that changed code, a quick question about that exact change appears above the prompt; answer with /a 1-4, see your weak spots with /teach stats. Needs function hooks (early access).

language.title: Quiz language
language.description: The language questions and explanations are written in. Code stays as it is.

quizModel.title: Quiz model
quizModel.description: Model alias that writes the questions. Haiku keeps it cheap.

cooldownMinutes.title: Minutes between questions
cooldownMinutes.description: At most one question per this many minutes, so it never nags.
